evidence_classes.DERIVED: Computed from other evidence in this pack rather than observed directly — an index, a gate result, or a checklist over recorded measurements.
evidence_classes.HISTORICAL_LIVE_MODEL: A live-model run recorded earlier and referenced, never re-executed. Kept byte-identical so a later batch cannot quietly restate it.
evidence_classes.OFFLINE_DETERMINISTIC: Deterministic, reproducible and free. The Truth Engine, crossings and proof generator are production code; only the models are substituted.
evidence_classes.REAL_GOOGLE_CLOUD: Observed against live Google Cloud resources in driftzero-runtime-2026 — Cloud Run, Firestore, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub. Not a mock and not a fixture.
evidence_classes.REAL_MAAS_EXECUTION: Produced by real inference on Vertex AI MaaS, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-maas, serverless ON_DEMAND. Each record carries the input hash and token usage.
evidence_classes.REAL_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE: Photographs of a real box with a printed label, taken with a camera. Nothing generated, rendered or composited occupies these paths.

hash_guarantee.covers: complete file bytes of each listed artifact
hash_guarantee.establishes: content identity and alteration detection only
hash_guarantee.not_the_same_as_change_proof_content_has: ChangeProof.content_hash is a SHA-256 over the proof's canonical JSON EXCLUDING its own content_hash field. The hashes in this manifest are over whole files. The SHA-256 of a proof FILE is therefore expected to differ from the content_hash recorded inside it.
